_notes: A6 · Biometric enrollment (catalog A6, plan test-plans/journey-a/a06-biometric-enrollment.md, runner row A6; PET-12634, re-test WEBPET-1443). The reader is replaced by a run-built IrisID device file imported on screen through Single Folder; employee and IrisID scan device are created on screen and deleted in teardown.
Offsets feed runUniqueCode(): 61-63 are free (B15 uses 1-3, A4 41, A5 51-54).
templateBytes 540/2151/540 give base64 lengths 720/2868/720, the real file's. Templates are random per run and the picture is a canvas-drawn JPEG: no real biometric data is committed.

Device name is A6-NEW-DEVICE-<MMDD-HHmmss UTC>-W<worker> (readableName in runToken.ts): the workflow id keeps it apart from B15's device by name and mailbox, and referenceLead I vs Z keeps the reference prefix apart.
